name: Nagarain–Rahika National Highway
significance: NH 227L is a branch of NH 227. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Nagarain to Rahika, and it meets NH 227 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 227 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Chakia to Nirmali
